events.title: San Francisco Time Machine with Peter Hartlaub
events.why: SF Chronicle culture critic Peter Hartlaub fires up a time machine through the city photo archive: 1980s Mayor Art Agnos, Muni psychedelic worm-logo era, and Chronicle finds not fit to print.

events.title: Fred Frith's FREMAKAJO + Jordan Glenn's BEAK
events.why: Avant-garde guitar legend Fred Frith (Henry Cow, downtown NYC) brings his new ensemble FREMAKAJO to the Ivy Room, sharing a bill with Jordan Glenn's BEAK.

events.price_note: $15 suggested donation; pay what you want
events.title: BYOB (Bring Your Own Beamer) Pop-Up Projector Show
events.why: Rafaël Rozendaal's BYOB format returns to Gray Area: artists bring their own projectors and take over the space with ephemeral generative visuals, strange hardware contraptions, and immersive projection art.

events.title: Dr. Desiré Whitmore and Ben Goldberg: LIGO plus Clarinet (After Dark)
events.why: Exploratorium physicist Dr. Desiré Whitmore explains the Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory while Ben Goldberg threads clarinet explorations through the talk. Science and sound in the same room.

events.title: Black August Film Screening: The Strike
events.why: Malcolm X Grassroots Movement Oakland screens The Strike, the 2024 documentary on the Pelican Bay hunger strike against solitary confinement, with a panel, community dinner, letter writing, and wellness sessions.

events.title: Merope w/ Shahzad Ismaily + David Wesley Golightly
events.why: Merope connects Lithuanian folk song with experimental guitar and electronics at the Lab, with Shahzad Ismaily and David Wesley Golightly. Jazz, traditional music, ambient, minimalism, and kosmische.

events.title: GODWAFFLE NOISE PANCAKES
events.why: 26 years of odd sounds and cyborscht: a noise-music marathon with free gourmet vegan pancakes and coffee, deep in the Oakland Hills at Fort Detrick Lymethrax.

events.title: Xicana Moratorium Block Party
events.why: EastSide Arts Alliance's annual Xicana Moratorium block party fills the street with live music, Aztec dance, screen printing, face painting, DJ La Femme Papi, and Fruitvale community organizations.

events.price_note: Tickets via Gray Area; two performances (2:30pm and 6pm doors)
events.title: Ambrose Trataris: Daisy-Chain Star-Connection
events.why: World premiere of a hybrid VR performance blending contemporary dance, drag artistry, 3D world design, and motion capture. Queer worldbuilding across virtual and physical realities with Bay Area performers live and as holograms.

events.title: CROSSROADS 2026 Experimental Film Festival
events.why: San Francisco Cinematheque's annual festival at Gray Area: 49 works by 52 artists from 22 countries in 8 programs. Highlight: JG Thirlwell live-scores Harry Smith's occult classic Heaven and Earth Magic.

events.title: Agentworld x Superdark Factory: Antikythera x Disintegrator
events.why: Philosopher of technology Benjamin Bratton (The Stack) and Marek Poliks deliver a double-lecture on how trillions of AI agents and fully automated systems will reconfigure society. Planetary computation meets speculative futures.

events.title: Remillard Park to Grizzly Peak (Berkeley Path Wanderers)
events.why: A fast-paced hike covering 12 hidden Berkeley paths (7 uphill, 4 down, 1 flat) from Remillard Park to Grizzly Peak. Secret stairs, hillside trails, and ridge views with the Path Wanderers.

events.title: Eraserhead Xiu Xiu
events.why: Xiu Xiu performs their live score to David Lynch's Eraserhead at Gray Area. Industrial clamor, uncanny crooning, and the original film projected in the Grand Theater.

events.title: Unseen Visions: A New Age Music and Culture Symposium
events.why: A full-day symposium of films, lectures, and performances exploring New Age music and culture. Consciousness, perception, and the spiritual-technological ferment of the 1970s-80s counterculture.

events.price_note: Free; register for in-person or virtual
events.title: Internet Archive Annual Celebration: Democracy's Library
events.why: Internet Archive's annual gathering explores Democracy's Library and tools for participation. Open-web, public-access, and media-preservation advocacy at the Archive's San Francisco home.
